Slow extras

Three ways to do almost nothing

From the guest book

Written at the bale, in pencil

“We booked two nights and stayed five. The loudest sound all week was the frangipani dropping into the pool.”
— Guest book, sample entry · Plumeria room

Rumah Teduh is our house first and a stay second — four rooms is where it stops feeling like family, so four is where we stopped. If the dates you want are gone, write to us anyway; the garden has a way of rearranging itself.

— Made & Kadek, your hosts

What time are check-in and check-out?

Check-in from 14.00, check-out at 11.00. Arriving on the morning flight? The bale, the pool and the coffee are yours while the room is made ready.

Can children stay?

Children over ten are welcome — the pool is deep and the house is quiet by design. Kayu Manis fits a third bed for exactly this.

How do we pay?

Nothing is charged when you reserve. You pay at the house — card, transfer or cash — and only after you have seen the room.

What if our plans change?

Cancel free of charge until 3 days before check-in, by replying to the confirmation email. Later than that, the first night is charged — and can be moved once, free.
